archetype: Editorial Romance (Pastel/Warm palette with Brutalist Swiss grid structure for tension)
instructions_to_main_agent: Design a 2026 Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level wedding website.
Do not use standard SaaS templates. Embrace asymmetry, overlap, and editorial serpentine flows.
Ensure 'Lenis' is used for smooth momentum scrolling.
Use 'Framer Motion' for on-load masked text reveals and scroll-triggered micro-interactions.
Hero must feature a large kinetic text reveal (masked line-by-line) and a subtle parallax or 3D moment.
Treat photography like a fashion editorial—spotlight hover effects, clipped frames, and varying aspect ratios (tall portraits mixed with wide landscapes).
Include a global subtle film grain texture overlay to make it feel tactile.
RSVP button must open the Notion form link in a new tab: https://marble-beauty-7d8.notion.site/d80b8f568d5d4ad4a8003ebc23afeee2
Add a floating background music toggle (Play/Pause) fixed to the viewport.
Implement a guest well-wishes board connecting to a small backend.

headings.usage: Massive sizes (text-6xl to text-[9vw] on desktop), tight tracking, mixed with italicized words for romantic tension.

body.usage: Clean geometric contrast against the ornate serif. Used for dates, times, UI labels, and small narrative text.

rules: Avoid pure white or pure black. Always tint neutrals with warmth.
Use 'Jaipur Rose' and 'Palace Green' sparingly for CTA hover states, thin borders, or small decorative text.
Text over images must use 'champagne' or 'primary background' with adequate contrast.

visual_enhancers.grain_overlay: A fixed full-screen div with pointer-events-none, mix-blend-multiply, opacity-20, and a noise background image.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #422B22 (Dark Umber) with 10% to 20% opacity for architectural grid lines.
visual_enhancers.corners: Minimal border radius (max 4px). Sharp edges evoke high-fashion print layouts.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid soft drop shadows. Use hard flat shadows or purely rely on 1px borders for definition.

layouts_and_grids.hero: Full viewport height. Split or overlapping layout. A massive arch-masked image or video of a Jaipur palace/couple. Massive 'Amy & Aman' text revealing line-by-line via Framer Motion mask on load. Fixed editorial countdown at the bottom edge.
layouts_and_grids.our_story: Numbered manifesto format ('01', '02', '03'). Left-aligned oversized numbers with a thin vertical tracking line connecting them. Text is right-aligned in a 12-column grid.
layouts_and_grids.wedding_details: Bento-style or Swiss architectural grid. Cards with p-8 or p-12 padding. 1px borders separating them. Data points (Venue, Dates, Location, Guest Count) styled as high-contrast minimalist metadata.
layouts_and_grids.schedule: A two-day vertical timeline (Dec 17 & 18). Asymmetrical staggering. Use 'Outfit' font for the times and 'Cormorant' for the event titles.
layouts_and_grids.gallery: Masonry or overlapping 'DOCU-Editorial' style. Images varying in size (e.g., col-span-2 row-span-3 mixed with col-span-4 row-span-2). Add a slow scrolling editorial marquee between the schedule and gallery.
layouts_and_grids.guest_board: A horizontal scrolling strip or a tight masonry grid of short messages fetched from the backend.
layouts_and_grids.rsvp_section: Massive typography 'We can't wait to celebrate with you.' with a large, pill-shaped or sharp-edged primary button pointing to the Notion link.

motion_and_interactions.text_reveal: framer-motion: initial { y: '100%' }, animate { y: 0 } masked inside an overflow-hidden wrapper.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for images moving slightly slower than the scroll speed.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images scale up slightly (1.05) inside their clipped bounding box. Buttons feature a magnetic pull effect or an arrow that translates up and right.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: One very slow, continuous text ribbon reading 'JAIPUR, INDIA — DECEMBER 17 & 18, 2026 —' in large outline text.

components_to_build: ManifestoStory (Numbered chapters with scroll progress line)
WeddingDetailsGrid (Swiss grid cards with thin borders)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the 'Cormorant' serif font is legible by maintaining minimum 4.5:1 ratio over the warm bone background.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion and Lenis scroll effects.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid to RSVP button, music toggle, and well-wishes form submission.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Use p-12 to p-24 for main sections.
Use Lucide icons (or Phosphor) for UI actions.
Do not use generic Shadcn components out of the box for the marketing sections. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layout to preserve the editorial style.
Must use exact image URLs provided, no placeholders.
